title: Static Cutaway Rind and Aril Chambers Pomegranate
description: One wholly newly authored schematic pomegranate cutaway at approximate natural fruit scale. A rounded three-quarter red rind retains a thick pale inner wall and two real front quadrant cut faces. A complete dry six-lobed calyx crown remains attached at the neck. Behind the opening, a pale spongy backing carries thirty-five whole closed representative red arils in five unequal clusters, separated by exposed pale corridors. All geometry is newly drawn, not an opened pea pod with more seeds, a recoloured cacao fruit or extracted prior plant parts. One complete teaching cutaway prop, zero scenes. The exposed backing is deliberately simplified to a recessed plane; aril count, chambers and internal arrangement are schematic, not taxonomic, cellular or anatomical exactness. Constant opaque PBR surfaces do not simulate translucent juice sacs. No nutrition, medical, edible-product, preparation, cultivation, growth or physical-stability claim. No rig, animation or interaction made or verified.
